reading: Nǐ de bàn fǎ zhēn hǎo!
english: Your idea is really good!

reading: Nǐ yào qù nǎ ge dì fang?
english: Which place are you going to?
gloss: إِلَى أَيِّ مَكَانٍ تُرِيدُ أَنْ تَذْهَبَ؟

reading: Zhè ge dì tiě zhàn rén zhēn duō.

script: 我在冰箱里发现了蛋糕！
reading: Wǒ zài bīng xiāng lǐ fā xiàn le dàn gāo!
english: I found cake in the fridge!

script: 我一个人，好想有人帮忙。
reading: Wǒ yí gè rén, hǎo xiǎng yǒu rén bāng máng.
english: I'm all alone, I wish someone would help.

script: 我想复习一下昨天的故事。
reading: Wǒ xiǎng fù xí yí xià zuó tiān de gù shì.
english: I want to go over yesterday's story again.

script: 我刚才洗了脚，现在很干净！
reading: Wǒ gāng cái xǐ le jiǎo, xiàn zài hěn gān jìng!
english: I just washed my feet, and now they're so clean!
gloss: غَسَلْتُ قَدَمَيَّ قَبْلَ قَلِيلٍ، وَهُمَا الْآنَ نَظِيفَتَانِ جِدًّا!
gloss_reading: Ghasaltu qadamayya qabla qalīl, wahumā al-ʾāna naẓīfatāni jiddan!

script: 我好像感冒了，头有点儿疼。

english: I think I've caught a cold. My head hurts a little.
gloss: أَظُنُّ أَنَّنِي أُصِبْتُ بِالزُّكَامِ، رَأْسِي يُؤْلِمُنِي قَلِيلًا.
gloss_reading: Aẓunnu annanī uṣibtu bi-z-zukām, raʾsī yuʾlimunī qalīlan.

script: 我对你的手机很感兴趣。
reading: Wǒ duì nǐ de shǒu jī hěn gǎn xìng qù.
english: I'm really curious about your phone.

script: 刚才有一只鸟从我头上飞过去。

gloss_reading: Ṭāra ṭāʾirun fawqa raʾsī qabla qalīl.

reading: Tiān yīn le, wǒ dān xīn huì xià yǔ.

gloss: أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَذْهَبَ مَعَكَ إِلَى الْحَدِيقَةِ.

gloss_reading: Yadāka aḥabbu shayʾin ilayy, wahumā murīḥatān.

script: 公园里的花开了，好看极了！
reading: Gōng yuán lǐ de huā kāi le, hǎo kàn jí le!
english: The flowers in the park are out. They're so pretty!
gloss: تَفَتَّحَتِ الْأَزْهَارُ فِي الْحَدِيقَةِ، مَا أَجْمَلَهَا!
gloss_reading: Tafattaḥati al-ʾazhāru fī al-ḥadīqa, mā ajmalahā!

gloss_reading: Ar-rīḥu tahubbu fī al-khārij, lā urīdu an akhruj.

reading: Qǐng bǎ dēng guān le, wǒ xiǎng shuì jiào.
english: Please turn off the light. I want to sleep.
gloss: مِنْ فَضْلِكَ أَطْفِئِ الْمِصْبَاحَ، أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَنَامَ.
gloss_reading: Min faḍlika aṭfiʾi al-miṣbāḥ, urīdu an anām.

reading: Nǐ hé wǒ de guān xi zuì hǎo le!
english: You and I are the best of friends!

reading: Xiè xie nǐ zhè me guān xīn wǒ.
english: Thank you for caring about me so much.
gloss: شُكْرًا لَكَ عَلَى اهْتِمَامِكَ الْكَبِيرِ بِي.
gloss_reading: Shukran laka ʿalā ihtimāmika al-kabīri bī.

script: 关于明天，你有什么打算？
reading: Guān yú míng tiān, nǐ yǒu shén me dǎ suàn?
english: What are your plans for tomorrow?
gloss: بِخُصُوصِ الْغَدِ، مَاذَا تَنْوِي أَنْ تَفْعَلَ؟

gloss: فِي الْمَاضِي كُنْتُ أَسْكُنُ فِي الْمَاءِ.
gloss_reading: Fī al-māḍī kuntu askunu fī al-māʾ.

english: Would you like cake or bread?

english: It is pouring outside. I am so scared.
gloss: الْمَطَرُ غَزِيرٌ فِي الْخَارِجِ، أَنَا خَائِفٌ جِدًّا.
gloss_reading: Al-maṭaru ghazīrun fī al-khārij, anā khāʾifun jiddan.

script: 黑板上写的字，我看不懂。
reading: Hēi bǎn shàng xiě de zì, wǒ kàn bù dǒng.
english: I can't read what's written on the blackboard.
gloss: لَا أَفْهَمُ مَا كُتِبَ عَلَى السَّبُّورَةِ.
gloss_reading: Lā afhamu mā kutiba ʿalā as-sabbūra.

reading: Wǒ xiǎng bǎ qián huā zài hǎo chī de dōng xi shàng.
english: I want to spend my money on tasty things.
gloss: أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُنْفِقَ مَالِي عَلَى أَشْيَاءَ لَذِيذَةٍ.
gloss_reading: Urīdu an unfiqa mālī ʿalā ashyāʾa ladhīdha.

reading: Wǒ xiǎng huà yì zhī dà yú.
english: I want to draw a big fish.

script: 我的东西坏了，你能帮我吗？
reading: Wǒ de dōng xi huài le, nǐ néng bāng wǒ ma?
english: Something of mine is broken. Can you help me?
gloss: انْكَسَرَ شَيْءٌ مِنْ أَغْرَاضِي، هَلْ تُسَاعِدُنِي؟

gloss_reading: Urīdu an antaqila ilā baytin jadīd.

reading: Zhè shì gè hǎo jī huì, wǒ men chū qù wán ba!

gloss_reading: Daʿnī afḥaṣ hal fī ḥaqībatika ṭaʿām.

gloss_reading: Hādhā sahlun jiddan, anā ayḍan astaṭīʿ!

gloss_reading: Kuli al-fākihata kathīran litakūna biṣiḥḥatin jayyida.

reading: Míng tiān jiàn miàn shí, wǒ yǒu dōng xi yào gěi nǐ kàn.
english: When we meet tomorrow, I have something to show you.
gloss: عِنْدَمَا نَلْتَقِي غَدًا، عِنْدِي شَيْءٌ أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُرِيَكَ إِيَّاهُ.

english: Two little fish are getting married!

english: When does the meeting end?

reading: Wǒ bú huì zuò zhè ge, nǐ néng bāng wǒ jiě jué ma?
english: I can't do this. Can you sort it out for me?
gloss: لَا أَعْرِفُ كَيْفَ أَفْعَلُ هٰذَا، هَلْ تُسَاعِدُنِي فِي حَلِّهِ؟
gloss_reading: Lā aʿrifu kayfa afʿalu hādhā, hal tusāʿidunī fī ḥallih?

script: 我可以借你的椅子坐一下吗？
reading: Wǒ kě yǐ jiè nǐ de yǐ zi zuò yí xià ma?
english: Can I borrow your chair for a bit?
gloss: هَلْ أَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ أَسْتَعِيرَ كُرْسِيَّكَ لِلْجُلُوسِ قَلِيلًا؟
gloss_reading: Hal astaṭīʿu an astaʿīra kursiyyaka li-l-julūsi qalīlan?

english: Why do you so often ignore me?

english: I saw a cat pass by the door.

english: Is your manager in a bad mood today?

script: 你走了好久，我一个人好难过。

english: You have been gone so long. I am so sad on my own.
gloss: ذَهَبْتَ مُنْذُ وَقْتٍ طَوِيلٍ، وَأَنَا حَزِينٌ جِدًّا وَحْدِي.

gloss_reading: Hal tuʿallimunī kayfa aqūlu hādhihi al-jumla?

gloss_reading: Anā ʿaṭshān, urīdu an ashraba māʾan.

english: I am parched. Quick, get me some water!
gloss: أَنَا عَطْشَانُ جِدًّا، أَعْطِنِي مَاءً بِسُرْعَةٍ!
gloss_reading: Anā ʿaṭshānu jiddan, aʿṭinī māʾan bisurʿa!

reading: Wǒ hǎo hài pà, bié fàng kāi wǒ!
english: I'm so scared. Don't let go!

script: 我的脚好疼，是不是坏了？
reading: Wǒ de jiǎo hǎo téng, shì bu shì huài le?
english: My foot really hurts. Is it broken?
gloss: قَدَمِي تُؤْلِمُنِي كَثِيرًا، هَلْ هِيَ مَكْسُورَةٌ؟
gloss_reading: Qadamī tuʾlimunī kathīran, hal hiya maksūra?

script: 我刚才睡着了，现在有力气了。
reading: Wǒ gāng cái shuì zháo le, xiàn zài yǒu lì qi le.
english: I was just asleep, and now I have some energy.
gloss: نِمْتُ قَبْلَ قَلِيلٍ، وَالْآنَ عِنْدِي قُوَّةٌ.
gloss_reading: Nimtu qabla qalīl, wa-l-ʾāna ʿindī quwwa.

script: 早上好，今天有什么好节目？
reading: Zǎo shang hǎo, jīn tiān yǒu shén me hǎo jié mù?
english: Good morning! Any good shows on today?
gloss: صَبَاحُ الْخَيْرِ، أَيُّ بَرْنَامَجٍ جَيِّدٍ الْيَوْمَ؟
gloss_reading: Ṣabāḥu al-khayr, ayyu barnāmajin jayyidin al-yawm?

reading: Yòu jiàn miàn le, wǒ hǎo gāo xìng!
english: We meet again. I'm so happy!

reading: Wǒ xiān zǒu le, míng tiān jiàn!
english: I'm heading off first. See you tomorrow!
gloss: سَأَذْهَبُ أَنَا أَوَّلًا، إِلَى اللِّقَاءِ غَدًا!
gloss_reading: Saʾadhhabu anā awwalan, ilā al-liqāʾi ghadan!

reading: Bié guān diàn nǎo, wǒ hái xiǎng wán.
english: Don't turn off the computer. I still want to play.
gloss: لَا تُطْفِئِ الْحَاسُوبَ، مَا زِلْتُ أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَلْعَبَ.
gloss_reading: Lā tuṭfiʾi al-ḥāsūb, mā ziltu urīdu an alʿab.

script: 没有你，我一个人好难过，想哭。
reading: Méi yǒu nǐ, wǒ yí gè rén hǎo nán guò, xiǎng kū.
english: Without you I'm all alone and so sad I want to cry.
gloss: بِدُونِكَ أَنَا وَحِيدٌ وَحَزِينٌ جِدًّا، أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَبْكِيَ.
gloss_reading: Bidūnika anā waḥīdun waḥazīnun jiddan, urīdu an abkiy.

script: 谢谢你的蛋糕，好吃极了！
reading: Xiè xie nǐ de dàn gāo, hǎo chī jí le!
english: Thanks for the cake. It's delicious!

reading: Zài gěi wǒ yì kǒu, hǎo bu hǎo?
english: Give me one more bite, okay?

reading: Wǒ gèng è le, nǐ yǒu chī de ma?
english: I'm even hungrier now. Have you got anything to eat?
gloss: ازْدَادَ جُوعِي، هَلْ عِنْدَكَ شَيْءٌ لِلْأَكْلِ؟
gloss_reading: Izdāda jūʿī, hal ʿindaka shayʾun li-l-ʾakl?
note: settled by claude-adjudicated: blind reading means the same

script: 谢谢你关心我，我好高兴。
reading: Xiè xie nǐ guān xīn wǒ, wǒ hǎo gāo xìng.
english: Thanks for caring about me. I am so happy.
gloss: شُكْرًا لِاهْتِمَامِكَ بِي، أَنَا سَعِيدٌ جِدًّا.
gloss_reading: Shukran lihtimāmika bī, anā saʿīdun jiddan.

script: 我们经常一起玩，我最开心了！
reading: Wǒ men jīng cháng yì qǐ wán, wǒ zuì kāi xīn le!
english: We often play together, and it makes me so happy!
gloss: نَلْعَبُ مَعًا كَثِيرًا، وَهٰذَا يُسْعِدُنِي جِدًّا!
gloss_reading: Nalʿabu maʿan kathīran, wahādhā yusʿidunī jiddan!

script: 你刚才去哪儿了？我想你了。
reading: Nǐ gāng cái qù nǎr le? Wǒ xiǎng nǐ le.
english: Where did you go just now? I missed you.
gloss: أَيْنَ ذَهَبْتَ قَبْلَ قَلِيلٍ؟ اشْتَقْتُ إِلَيْكَ.
gloss_reading: Ayna dhahabta qabla qalīl? Ishtaqtu ilayk.

reading: Tiān qì tài rè, wǒ xiǎng kāi kōng tiáo.
english: It's too hot. I want to turn on the air conditioning.
gloss: الْجَوُّ حَارٌّ جِدًّا، أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُشَغِّلَ الْمُكَيِّفَ.
gloss_reading: Al-jawwu ḥārrun jiddan, urīdu an ushaghghila al-mukayyif.

reading: Mén méi guān, fēng jìn lái le.
english: The door is not shut and the wind is coming in.

reading: Nǐ huàn le xīn kù zi, zhēn hǎo kàn!
english: You changed into new trousers. They look great!

reading: Wǒ huà le nǐ, nǐ kàn xiàng bu xiàng?
english: I drew you. Does it look like you?

script: 我对做饭很感兴趣，教教我吧。
reading: Wǒ duì zuò fàn hěn gǎn xìng qù, jiāo jiāo wǒ ba.
english: I'm interested in cooking. Teach me!

script: 你是晚上回来，还是明天早上回来？
reading: Nǐ shì wǎn shang huí lái, hái shì míng tiān zǎo shang huí lái?
english: Are you coming back tonight or tomorrow morning?
gloss: هَلْ سَتَعُودُ فِي الْمَسَاءِ أَمْ صَبَاحَ الْغَدِ؟
gloss_reading: Hal sataʿūdu fī al-masāʾi am ṣabāḥa al-ghad?

script: 你决定去哪个公园了吗？
reading: Nǐ jué dìng qù nǎ ge gōng yuán le ma?
english: Have you decided which park to go to?
gloss: هَلْ قَرَّرْتَ إِلَى أَيِّ حَدِيقَةٍ تَذْهَبُ؟
gloss_reading: Hal qarrarta ilā ayyi ḥadīqatin tadhhab?

script: 这个季节，公园里的花最多。
reading: Zhè ge jì jié, gōng yuán lǐ de huā zuì duō.
english: In this season the park has the most flowers.
gloss: فِي هٰذَا الْفَصْلِ تَكُونُ الْأَزْهَارُ فِي الْحَدِيقَةِ أَكْثَرَ مَا يَكُونُ.
gloss_reading: Fī hādhā al-faṣli takūnu al-ʾazhāru fī al-ḥadīqati akthara mā yakūn.

script: 我不想让今天结束，再玩一会儿吧。
reading: Wǒ bù xiǎng ràng jīn tiān jié shù, zài wán yí huìr ba.
english: I don't want today to end. Let's play a little longer.
gloss: لَا أُرِيدُ أَنْ يَنْتَهِيَ الْيَوْمُ، لِنَلْعَبْ لَحْظَةً أُخْرَى.
gloss_reading: Lā urīdu an yantahiya al-yawm, linalʿab laḥẓatan ukhrā.

script: 快到节日了，我想吃好吃的。
reading: Kuài dào jié rì le, wǒ xiǎng chī hǎo chī de.
english: The festival is nearly here. I want something yummy.
gloss: الْعِيدُ قَرِيبٌ، أُرِيدُ أَنْ آكُلَ شَيْئًا لَذِيذًا.
gloss_reading: Al-ʿīdu qarīb, urīdu an ākula shayʾan ladhīdhan.
note: settled by claude-adjudicated: blind reading means the same as the English (wording only)

script: 你的声音真好听，再讲一个故事吧。
reading: Nǐ de shēng yīn zhēn hǎo tīng, zài jiǎng yí gè gù shì ba.
english: Your voice is lovely. Tell me another story.
gloss: صَوْتُكَ جَمِيلٌ جِدًّا، احْكِ لِي قِصَّةً أُخْرَى.
gloss_reading: Ṣawtuka jamīlun jiddan, iḥki lī qiṣṣatan ukhrā.

script: 我几乎什么都记得，就是忘了你的生日。
reading: Wǒ jī hū shén me dōu jì de, jiù shì wàng le nǐ de shēng rì.
english: I remember almost everything, except I forgot your birthday.
gloss: أَتَذَكَّرُ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ تَقْرِيبًا، لٰكِنِّي نَسِيتُ عِيدَ مِيلَادِكَ.
gloss_reading: Atadhakkaru kulla shayʾin taqrīban, lākinnī nasītu ʿīda mīlādik.

reading: Wǒ xiǎng jiè nǐ de shū kàn kan.
english: I'd like to borrow your book.

script: 会议开完了吗？我想找你玩。
reading: Huì yì kāi wán le ma? Wǒ xiǎng zhǎo nǐ wán.
english: Is the meeting over? I want to play with you.
gloss: هَلِ انْتَهَى الِاجْتِمَاعُ؟ أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَلْعَبَ مَعَكَ.
gloss_reading: Hali intahā al-ijtimāʿ? Urīdu an alʿaba maʿak.

script: 我们一起检查一下冰箱吧。
reading: Wǒ men yì qǐ jiǎn chá yí xià bīng xiāng ba.
english: Let us check the fridge together.

reading: Lán sè de dōng xi, wǒ dōu xǐ huan.
english: I like anything blue.

reading: Wǒ pà hēi, nǐ bié guān dēng.
english: I'm afraid of the dark. Don't turn off the light.
gloss: أَخَافُ مِنَ الظَّلَامِ، لَا تُطْفِئِ الضَّوْءَ.
gloss_reading: Akhāfu mina aẓ-ẓalām, lā tuṭfiʾi aḍ-ḍawʾ.

script: 你为什么哭了？谁让你不高兴？
reading: Nǐ wèi shén me kū le? Shéi ràng nǐ bù gāo xìng?
english: Why are you crying? Who upset you?

script: 后来你去哪儿了？我等了你很久。
reading: Hòu lái nǐ qù nǎr le? Wǒ děng le nǐ hěn jiǔ.
english: Where did you go afterwards? I waited for you a long time.
gloss: وَبَعْدَ ذٰلِكَ أَيْنَ ذَهَبْتَ؟ انْتَظَرْتُكَ طَوِيلًا.
gloss_reading: Wabaʿda dhālika ayna dhahabt? Intaẓartuka ṭawīlan.

reading: Nǐ men guó jiā yǒu shén me jié rì?
english: What festivals does your country have?

reading: Wǒ xiǎng xué zěn me jiě jué wèn tí.
english: I want to learn how to solve problems.
gloss: أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَتَعَلَّمَ كَيْفَ أَحُلُّ الْمَشَاكِلَ.
gloss_reading: Urīdu an ataʿallama kayfa aḥullu al-mashākil.

script: 我不想换衣服，我喜欢这件。
reading: Wǒ bù xiǎng huàn yī fu, wǒ xǐ huan zhè jiàn.
english: I do not want to change clothes. I like this one.
gloss: لَا أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُبَدِّلَ مَلَابِسِي، أُحِبُّ هٰذِهِ.
gloss_reading: Lā urīdu an ubaddila malābisī, uḥibbu hādhih.

reading: Nǐ jīn tiān jiǎn chá zuò yè le ma?
english: Did you check your homework today?

reading: Wǒ huà de huā hǎo kàn ma?
english: Does the flower I drew look nice?

script: 你每天都很忙，我很关心你。
reading: Nǐ měi tiān dōu hěn máng, wǒ hěn guān xīn nǐ.
english: You are busy every day. I care about you.
gloss: أَنْتَ مَشْغُولٌ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ، وَأَنَا أَهْتَمُّ بِكَ كَثِيرًا.
gloss_reading: Anta mashghūlun kulla yawm, waʾanā ahtammu bika kathīran.

script: 今天刮风，我们别去公园了。
reading: Jīn tiān guā fēng, wǒ men bié qù gōng yuán le.
english: It is windy today. Let us not go to the park.
gloss: الرِّيحُ تَهُبُّ الْيَوْمَ، فَلَا نَذْهَبْ إِلَى الْحَدِيقَةِ.
gloss_reading: Ar-rīḥu tahubbu al-yawm, falā nadhhab ilā al-ḥadīqa.

script: 你的老朋友今天会来吗？
reading: Nǐ de lǎo péng you jīn tiān huì lái ma?
english: Is your old friend coming today?

script: 我喜欢甜的东西，例如蛋糕和苹果。
reading: Wǒ xǐ huan tián de dōng xi, lì rú dàn gāo hé píng guǒ.
english: I like sweet things, like cake and apples.
gloss: أُحِبُّ الْأَشْيَاءَ الْحُلْوَةَ، مِثْلَ الْكَعْكِ وَالتُّفَّاحِ.
gloss_reading: Uḥibbu al-ʾashyāʾa al-ḥulwa, mithla al-kaʿki wa-t-tuffāḥ.

script: 我的脸有点儿绿，你看到了吗？
reading: Wǒ de liǎn yǒu diǎnr lǜ, nǐ kàn dào le ma?
english: My face is a little green. Did you notice?
gloss: وَجْهِي أَخْضَرُ قَلِيلًا، هَلْ رَأَيْتَ ذٰلِكَ؟
gloss_reading: Wajhī akhḍaru qalīlan, hal raʾayta dhālik?

reading: Wǒ měi tiān dōu liàn xí tiào wǔ.
english: I practise dancing every day.

script: 一辆红色的车开过去了。
reading: Yí liàng hóng sè de chē kāi guò qù le.
english: A red car just drove past.

reading: Wǒ xiǎng duō liǎo jiě nǐ yì diǎnr.
english: I want to get to know you a little better.

script: 邻居家的猫今天又来了。
reading: Lín jū jiā de māo jīn tiān yòu lái le.
english: The neighbour's cat came over again today.
gloss: جَاءَتْ قِطَّةُ الْجِيرَانِ الْيَوْمَ مِنْ جَدِيدٍ.
gloss_reading: Jāʾat qiṭṭatu al-jīrāni al-yawma min jadīd.

script: 另外，我还想吃一片面包。
reading: Lìng wài, wǒ hái xiǎng chī yí piàn miàn bāo.
english: Also, I would like a slice of bread.

script: 你走的时候，能不能给我留着灯？
reading: Nǐ zǒu de shí hou, néng bu néng gěi wǒ liú zhe dēng?
english: When you go, could you leave the light on for me?
gloss: هَلْ تَتْرُكُ لِيَ الضَّوْءَ مُضَاءً عِنْدَمَا تَذْهَبُ؟
gloss_reading: Hal tatruku liya aḍ-ḍawʾa muḍāʾan ʿindamā tadhhab?

reading: Nǐ liú xià lái, hǎo bu hǎo?
english: Will you stay, please?

reading: Zhè lǐ de lóu hǎo gāo a!
english: The buildings here are so tall!

reading: Wǒ shì lǜ sè de, nǐ xǐ huan ma?
english: I'm green. Do you like it?

reading: Wǒ mǎ shàng jiù hǎo, děng wǒ yí xià.
english: I'll be ready in a moment, wait for me.
gloss: سَأَكُونُ جَاهِزًا بَعْدَ قَلِيلٍ، اِنْتَظِرْنِي لَحْظَةً.
gloss_reading: Saʾakūnu jāhizan baʿda qalīl, intaẓirnī laḥẓa.

reading: Wǒ duì jīn tiān hěn mǎn yì.
english: I'm very happy with today.

reading: Nǐ de mào zi zhēn hǎo kàn!
english: Your hat looks great!

reading: Wǒ zhǐ yǒu yì mǐ gāo, hěn xiǎo ba?
english: I'm only one metre tall. Pretty small, right?
gloss: طُولِي مِتْرٌ وَاحِدٌ فَقَطْ، أَلَسْتُ صَغِيرًا؟
gloss_reading: Ṭūlī mitrun wāḥidun faqaṭ, alastu ṣaghīran?
note: settled by claude-adjudicated: blind reading means the same as the English (wording only)

reading: Wǒ è le, xiǎng chī miàn bāo.
english: I'm hungry. I want some bread.
gloss: أَنَا جَائِعٌ، أُرِيدُ أَنْ آكُلَ خُبْزًا.
gloss_reading: Anā jāʾiʿ, urīdu an ākula khubzan.

reading: Miàn bāo zhēn xiāng!
english: The bread smells so good!

script: 我明白了，你是想让我安静一点儿。
reading: Wǒ míng bái le, nǐ shì xiǎng ràng wǒ ān jìng yì diǎnr.
english: I get it. You want me to be quiet.
gloss: فَهِمْتُ، أَنْتَ تُرِيدُ أَنْ أَهْدَأَ قَلِيلًا.
gloss_reading: Fahimt, anta turīdu an ahdaʾa qalīlan.

script: 我想拿那个苹果，可是拿不到。
reading: Wǒ xiǎng ná nà ge píng guǒ, kě shì ná bú dào.
english: I want to grab that apple, but I can't reach it.
gloss: أُرِيدُ أَنْ آخُذَ تِلْكَ التُّفَّاحَةَ، لٰكِنَّنِي لَا أَصِلُ إِلَيْهَا.
gloss_reading: Urīdu an ākhudha tilka at-tuffāḥa, lākinnanī lā aṣilu ilayhā.

reading: Bié ná zǒu wǒ de dōng xi!
english: Don't take my things!

reading: Nǐ nǎi nai jīn tiān huì lái ma?
english: Is your grandmother coming today?

reading: Xiǎo niǎo wǎng nán fēi le.
english: The birds flew south.

script: 你要走了，我有点儿难过。
reading: Nǐ yào zǒu le, wǒ yǒu diǎnr nán guò.
english: You're leaving, and I feel a bit sad.

script: 我今天很难过，你和我玩吧。
reading: Wǒ jīn tiān hěn nán guò, nǐ hé wǒ wán ba.
english: I'm sad today. Play with me, please.

reading: Nǐ xiàn zài shì jǐ nián jí?
english: What grade are you in now?

reading: Nǐ kàn qǐ lái hěn nián qīng!
english: You look so young!

reading: Yǒu yì zhī niǎo zài shù shàng chàng gē.
english: A bird is singing in the tree.

reading: Wǒ huì nǔ lì de!
english: I'll try hard!

script: 我每天都很努力地练习。
reading: Wǒ měi tiān dōu hěn nǔ lì de liàn xí.
english: I work hard at practising every day.

reading: Zhōu mò wǒ men qù pá shān ba.
english: Let's go climbing on the weekend.

reading: Pá shān tài lèi le, wǒ xiǎng shuì jiào.
english: Climbing was so tiring. I want to sleep.
gloss: تَسَلُّقُ الْجَبَلِ مُتْعِبٌ جِدًّا، أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَنَامَ.
gloss_reading: Tasalluqu al-jabali mutʿibun jiddan, urīdu an anām.

reading: Pán zi lǐ hái yǒu yí kuài dàn gāo.
english: There's still a piece of cake on the plate.

reading: Wǒ shì bu shì biàn pàng le?
english: Have I gotten fat?

reading: Nǐ de pí xié hǎo liàng a!
english: Your leather shoes are so shiny!

script: 我不喝啤酒，我喜欢喝水。
reading: Wǒ bù hē pí jiǔ, wǒ xǐ huan hē shuǐ.
english: I don't drink beer. I like water.
gloss: لَا أَشْرَبُ الْبِيرَةَ، أُحِبُّ شُرْبَ الْمَاءِ.
gloss_reading: Lā ashrabu al-bīra, uḥibbu shurba al-māʾ.

reading: Píng zi lǐ méi yǒu shuǐ le.
english: There's no water left in the bottle.

reading: Qí shí wǒ bú tài è.
english: Actually, I'm not that hungry.

reading: Qí shí wǒ hěn xiǎng nǐ.
english: Actually, I really miss you.
gloss: فِي الْحَقِيقَةِ أَنَا أَشْتَاقُ إِلَيْكَ كَثِيرًا.
gloss_reading: Fī al-ḥaqīqati anā ashtāqu ilayka kathīran.

reading: Qí tā rén dōu qù nǎr le?
english: Where did everybody else go?

reading: Fēi jī mǎ shàng jiù yào qǐ fēi le.
english: The plane is about to take off.

script: 我没听清楚，你再说一遍吧。
reading: Wǒ méi tīng qīng chǔ, nǐ zài shuō yí biàn ba.
english: I did not catch that. Say it again.
gloss: لَمْ أَسْمَعْ جَيِّدًا، قُلْ ذٰلِكَ مَرَّةً أُخْرَى.
gloss_reading: Lam asmaʿ jayyidan, qul dhālika marratan ukhrā.

script: 今天我想请假，不想学习。
reading: Jīn tiān wǒ xiǎng qǐng jià, bù xiǎng xué xí.
english: I want to take the day off today. I don't feel like studying.
gloss: أُرِيدُ إِجَازَةً الْيَوْمَ، لَا أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَدْرُسَ.
gloss_reading: Urīdu ijāzatan al-yawm, lā urīdu an adrus.

reading: Qiū tiān dào le, tiān qì hěn hǎo.
english: Autumn is here and the weather is lovely.

reading: Wǒ xǐ huan qiū tiān de tài yáng.
english: I like the autumn sun.

reading: Nǐ de qún zi zhēn piào liang!
english: Your skirt is so pretty!

reading: Xiān chī fàn, rán hòu zài wán.
english: Eat first, then play.

script: 我先睡一会儿，然后再找你玩。
reading: Wǒ xiān shuì yí huìr, rán hòu zài zhǎo nǐ wán.
english: I'll take a nap first and then come play with you.
gloss: سَأَنَامُ قَلِيلًا أَوَّلًا، ثُمَّ آتِي لِأَلْعَبَ مَعَكَ.
gloss_reading: Saʾanāmu qalīlan awwalan, thumma ātī liʾalʿaba maʿak.

reading: Nǐ hǎo rè qíng a, wǒ xǐ huan nǐ!
english: You're so warm and friendly. I like you!
note: settled by claude-adjudicated: blind reading means the same as the English (wording only)

reading: Wǒ rèn wéi jīn tiān huì xià yǔ.
english: I think it's going to rain today.

reading: Nǐ rèn wéi wǒ kě ài ma?
english: Do you think I'm cute?

script: 你认真地看着我，我有点儿不好意思。
reading: Nǐ rèn zhēn de kàn zhe wǒ, wǒ yǒu diǎnr bù hǎo yì si.
english: You're looking at me so intently, and I'm a little shy.
gloss: تَنْظُرُ إِلَيَّ بِجِدٍّ، فَأَشْعُرُ بِالْخَجَلِ قَلِيلًا.
gloss_reading: Tanẓuru ilayya bijidd, faʾashʿuru bi-l-khajali qalīlan.

reading: Zhè ge wèn tí hěn róng yì.
english: This question is easy.

script: 如果你不在，我会很想你。
reading: Rú guǒ nǐ bú zài, wǒ huì hěn xiǎng nǐ.
english: If you're not here, I'll miss you a lot.
gloss: إِذَا لَمْ تَكُنْ هُنَا، فَسَأَشْتَاقُ إِلَيْكَ كَثِيرًا.
gloss_reading: Idhā lam takun hunā, fasaʾashtāqu ilayka kathīran.

script: 如果明天下雨，我们就在家玩。
reading: Rú guǒ míng tiān xià yǔ, wǒ men jiù zài jiā wán.
english: If it rains tomorrow, we'll play at home.
gloss: إِذَا أَمْطَرَتْ غَدًا، فَسَنَلْعَبُ فِي الْبَيْتِ.
gloss_reading: Idhā amṭarat ghadan, fasanalʿabu fī al-bayt.

script: 外面下雨了，你带伞了吗？
reading: Wài mian xià yǔ le, nǐ dài sǎn le ma?
english: It's raining out. Did you bring an umbrella?
gloss: السَّمَاءُ تُمْطِرُ فِي الْخَارِجِ، هَلْ أَخَذْتَ مِظَلَّةً؟
gloss_reading: As-samāʾu tumṭiru fī al-khārij, hal akhadhta miẓalla?

reading: Nà bǎ sǎn shì shéi de?
english: Whose umbrella is that?

reading: Nǐ zài shàng wǎng ma?
english: Are you online?

script: 你又上网了，不和我玩吗？
reading: Nǐ yòu shàng wǎng le, bù hé wǒ wán ma?
english: You're online again. Aren't you going to play with me?
gloss: أَنْتَ عَلَى الْإِنْتَرْنِتِ مِنْ جَدِيدٍ، أَلَنْ تَلْعَبَ مَعِي؟
gloss_reading: Anta ʿalā al-ʾintarniti min jadīd, alan talʿaba maʿī?

script: 你别生气，我不是故意的。
reading: Nǐ bié shēng qì, wǒ bú shì gù yì de.
english: Don't be angry. I didn't mean to.

script: 我生气了！你为什么把我放下？
reading: Wǒ shēng qì le! Nǐ wèi shén me bǎ wǒ fàng xià?
english: I'm angry! Why did you put me down?
gloss: أَنَا غَاضِبٌ! لِمَاذَا وَضَعْتَنِي عَلَى الْأَرْضِ؟
gloss_reading: Anā ghāḍib! Limādhā waḍaʿtanī ʿalā al-ʾarḍ?

script: 外面有很大的声音，我有点儿怕。
reading: Wài mian yǒu hěn dà de shēng yīn, wǒ yǒu diǎnr pà.
english: There's a loud noise outside. I'm a little scared.
gloss: هُنَاكَ صَوْتٌ عَالٍ فِي الْخَارِجِ، أَنَا خَائِفٌ قَلِيلًا.
gloss_reading: Hunāka ṣawtun ʿālin fī al-khārij, anā khāʾifun qalīlan.

reading: Nǐ de shēng yīn zhēn hǎo tīng.
english: Your voice is really nice.

reading: Zhè ge shì jiè zhēn dà a!
english: This world is so big!

reading: Wǒ xiǎng kàn kan wài mian de shì jiè.
english: I want to see the world outside.
gloss: أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَرَى الْعَالَمَ فِي الْخَارِجِ.
gloss_reading: Urīdu an arā al-ʿālama fī al-khārij.

reading: Wǒ xiǎng shì yi shì, kě yǐ ma?
english: I'd like to give it a try. May I?

reading: Zhè ge wǒ néng shì ma?
english: Can I try this?

reading: Nǐ zuì jìn shì bu shì shòu le?
english: Have you lost weight lately?

reading: Shū shu jīn tiān lái kàn nǐ le ma?
english: Did your uncle come to see you today?

reading: Zhè lǐ hǎo shū fu, wǒ xiǎng shuì le.
english: It's so comfortable here. I feel sleepy.
gloss: الْمَكَانُ هُنَا مُرِيحٌ جِدًّا، أَشْعُرُ بِالنُّعَاسِ.
gloss_reading: Al-makānu hunā murīḥun jiddan, ashʿuru bi-n-nuʿās.

reading: Zhè me gāo de shù, wǒ shàng bú qù.
english: I can't climb a tree that tall.
gloss: لَا أَسْتَطِيعُ تَسَلُّقَ شَجَرَةٍ بِهٰذَا الطُّولِ.
gloss_reading: Lā astaṭīʿu tasalluqa shajaratin bihādhā aṭ-ṭūl.

reading: Shù xià mian yǒu hěn duō xiǎo niǎo.
english: There are lots of little birds under the tree.

script: 你喜欢数学吗？我不太喜欢。
reading: Nǐ xǐ huan shù xué ma? Wǒ bú tài xǐ huan.
english: Do you like maths? I don't really.
gloss: هَلْ تُحِبُّ الرِّيَاضِيَّاتِ؟ لَا أُحِبُّهَا كَثِيرًا.
gloss_reading: Hal tuḥibbu ar-riyāḍiyyāt? Lā uḥibbuhā kathīran.

reading: Wǒ bú huì zuò shù xué tí.
english: I can't do maths problems.

reading: Nǐ shuā yá le ma?
english: Did you brush your teeth?

reading: Wǒ jīn tiān hái méi shuā yá.
english: I haven't brushed my teeth yet today.

reading: Nǐ yǒu liǎng shuāng xīn xié, zhēn hǎo!
english: You have two new pairs of shoes. How nice!
gloss: عِنْدَكَ زَوْجَانِ مِنَ الْأَحْذِيَةِ الْجَدِيدَةِ، رَائِعٌ!
gloss_reading: ʿIndaka zawjāni mina al-ʾaḥdhiyati al-jadīda, rāʾiʿ!

script: 我的水平还不高，要多练习。
reading: Wǒ de shuǐ píng hái bù gāo, yào duō liàn xí.
english: My level isn't high yet. I need to practise more.
gloss: لَمْ أَصِلْ إِلَى مُسْتَوًى عَالٍ بَعْدُ، عَلَيَّ أَنْ أَتَدَرَّبَ أَكْثَرَ.
gloss_reading: Lam aṣil ilā mustawan ʿālin baʿd, ʿalayya an atadarraba akthar.

reading: Nà wèi sī jī kāi chē hěn kuài.
english: That driver drives fast.

reading: Tài yáng chū lái le, hǎo rè!
english: The sun is out. So hot!

reading: Wǒ xǐ huan zài tài yáng xià shuì jiào.
english: I like sleeping in the sun.

reading: Jīn tiān tè bié kāi xīn!
english: I'm especially happy today!

reading: Wǒ tè bié xiǎng chī miàn tiáo.
english: I really want some noodles.

reading: Nǐ jīn tiān tè bié hǎo kàn.
english: You look extra nice today.

reading: Wǒ de tóu yǒu diǎnr téng.
english: My head hurts a little.

reading: Bié fàng shǒu! Wǒ huì téng de!
english: Don't let go! It'll hurt!

reading: Nǐ xiǎng tí gāo hàn yǔ shuǐ píng ma?
english: Do you want to improve your Chinese?
gloss: هَلْ تُرِيدُ أَنْ تُحَسِّنَ لُغَتَكَ الصِّينِيَّةَ؟
gloss_reading: Hal turīdu an tuḥassina lughataka aṣ-ṣīniyya?

reading: Wǒ xiǎng tí gāo wǒ de shuǐ píng.
english: I want to improve my level.

reading: Nǐ xǐ huan shàng tǐ yù kè ma?
english: Do you like PE class?

script: 你喜欢体育吗？我们一起运动吧。
reading: Nǐ xǐ huan tǐ yù ma? Wǒ men yì qǐ yùn dòng ba.
english: Do you like sports? Let us exercise together.

reading: Zhè ge píng guǒ zhēn tián!
english: This apple is so sweet!

reading: Hǎo tián a, wǒ hái xiǎng chī!
english: So sweet. I want more!

reading: Nǐ yǒu méi yǒu yì tiáo xīn qún zi?
english: Do you have a new skirt?

reading: Yǒu yì tiáo xiǎo yú zài shuǐ lǐ yóu.
english: There is a little fish swimming in the water.

reading: Nǐ de tóng shì duì nǐ hǎo ma?
english: Are your colleagues good to you?
gloss: هَلْ زُمَلَاؤُكَ فِي الْعَمَلِ طَيِّبُونَ مَعَكَ؟
gloss_reading: Hal zumalāʾuka fī al-ʿamali ṭayyibūna maʿak?

reading: Nǐ tóng shì jīn tiān lái le ma?
english: Did your colleague come in today?

reading: Wǒ tóng yì nǐ shuō de.
english: I agree with what you said.

reading: Nǐ tóng yì wǒ chū qù wán ma?
english: Do you agree to let me go out and play?
gloss: هَلْ تُوَافِقُ عَلَى أَنْ أَخْرُجَ لِأَلْعَبَ؟
gloss_reading: Hal tuwāfiqu ʿalā an akhruja liʾalʿab?

reading: Nǐ de tóu fa hǎo cháng a!
english: Your hair is so long!

script: 我的头发是绿色的，好看吗？
reading: Wǒ de tóu fa shì lǜ sè de, hǎo kàn ma?
english: My hair is green. Is it nice?

reading: Wài mian tū rán hēi le.
english: It suddenly got dark outside.

reading: Wǒ tū rán xiǎng shuì jiào le.
english: I suddenly feel like sleeping.

reading: Tū rán yǒu rén ná qǐ le wǒ!
english: Suddenly somebody picked me up!

reading: Nǐ yào qù tú shū guǎn ma?
english: Are you going to the library?

reading: Tú shū guǎn lǐ hěn ān jìng.
english: It's very quiet in the library.

reading: Wǒ de tuǐ hǎo lèi.
english: My legs are so tired.

reading: Wǒ de tuǐ tài duǎn le, pǎo bú kuài.
english: My legs are too short. I can't run fast.
gloss: سَاقَايَ قَصِيرَتَانِ جِدًّا، لَا أَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ أَرْكُضَ بِسُرْعَةٍ.
gloss_reading: Sāqāya qaṣīratāni jiddan, lā astaṭīʿu an arkuḍa bisurʿa.

reading: Nǐ wán chéng zuò yè le ma?
english: Did you finish your homework?

reading: Wǒ wán chéng le jīn tiān de liàn xí!
english: I finished today's practice!

reading: Wǒ yào yì wǎn rè de miàn tiáo.
english: I'd like a bowl of hot noodles.

reading: Zhè wǎn fàn zhēn hǎo chī!
english: This bowl of rice is so tasty!

reading: Wǒ děng le nǐ yí wàn nián!
english: I've waited ten thousand years for you!

script: 我的裙子是绿色的，你喜欢吗？
reading: Wǒ de qún zi shì lǜ sè de, nǐ xǐ huan ma?
english: My skirt is green. Do you like it?

script: 我又忘记你的名字了，对不起。
reading: Wǒ yòu wàng jì nǐ de míng zi le, duì bu qǐ.
english: I forgot your name again, sorry.

reading: Bié wàng jì gěi wǒ chī de.
english: Don't forget to give me something to eat!
gloss: لَا تَنْسَ أَنْ تُعْطِيَنِي شَيْئًا آكُلُهُ!
gloss_reading: Lā tansa an tuʿṭiyanī shayʾan ākuluh!

script: 为了你，我什么都愿意做。
reading: Wèi le nǐ, wǒ shén me dōu yuàn yì zuò.
english: I'd do anything for you.
gloss: مِنْ أَجْلِكَ، أَنَا مُسْتَعِدٌّ لِفِعْلِ أَيِّ شَيْءٍ.
gloss_reading: Min ajlik, anā mustaʿiddun lifiʿli ayyi shayʾ.

script: 今天有三位客人来看我。
reading: Jīn tiān yǒu sān wèi kè rén lái kàn wǒ.
english: Three guests came to see me today.

script: 我喜欢别的地方的文化。
reading: Wǒ xǐ huan bié de dì fang de wén huà.
english: I like the culture of other places.

script: 太阳从东边起来，从西边下去。
reading: Tài yáng cóng dōng biān qǐ lái, cóng xī biān xià qù.
english: The sun comes up in the east and goes down in the west.
gloss: تَطْلُعُ الشَّمْسُ مِنَ الشَّرْقِ وَتَغِيبُ فِي الْغَرْبِ.
gloss_reading: Taṭluʿu ash-shamsu mina ash-sharqi wataghību fī al-gharb.

script: 我已经习惯一个人在这里了。
reading: Wǒ yǐ jīng xí guàn yí gè rén zài zhè lǐ le.
english: I'm used to being here by myself now.
gloss: اِعْتَدْتُ الْآنَ أَنْ أَكُونَ هُنَا وَحْدِي.
gloss_reading: Iʿtadtu al-ʾāna an akūna hunā waḥdī.

reading: Zǎo qǐ shì gè hǎo xí guàn.
english: Getting up early is a good habit.

reading: Xǐ shǒu jiān zài nǎ lǐ? Wǒ xiǎng qù.
english: Where's the restroom? I want to go.
gloss: أَيْنَ دَوْرَةُ الْمِيَاهِ؟ أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَذْهَبَ.
gloss_reading: Ayna dawratu al-miyāh? Urīdu an adhhab.

script: 你什么时候洗澡？我也想洗。
reading: Nǐ shén me shí hou xǐ zǎo? Wǒ yě xiǎng xǐ.
english: When do you take a bath? I want one too.
gloss: مَتَى تَسْتَحِمُّ؟ أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَسْتَحِمَّ أَنَا أَيْضًا.
gloss_reading: Matā tastaḥimm? Urīdu an astaḥimma anā ayḍan.

reading: Xià tiān dào le, wǒ xiǎng qù yóu yǒng.
english: Summer is here, and I want to go swimming.
gloss: جَاءَ الصَّيْفُ، أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَذْهَبَ لِلسِّبَاحَةِ.
gloss_reading: Jāʾa aṣ-ṣayf, urīdu an adhhaba li-s-sibāḥa.

reading: Nǐ xiān chī, wǒ děng yí huìr.
english: You eat first, and I'll wait a bit.
gloss: كُلْ أَنْتَ أَوَّلًا، وَأَنَا سَأَنْتَظِرُ قَلِيلًا.
gloss_reading: Kul anta awwalan, waʾanā saʾantaẓiru qalīlan.

reading: Wǒ xiāng xìn nǐ huì huí lái de.
english: I believe you'll come back.

reading: Wǒ zuì ài chī de shì xiāng jiāo.
english: What I love to eat most is bananas.
gloss: أَكْثَرُ مَا أُحِبُّ أَكْلَهُ هُوَ الْمَوْزُ.
gloss_reading: Aktharu mā uḥibbu aklahu huwa al-mawz.

reading: Nǐ wèi shén me yì zhí xiàng wǒ xiào?
english: Why do you keep smiling at me?

reading: Wǒ xiàng yì tiáo xiǎo xiǎo de yú.
english: I look like a tiny fish.

reading: Lù shang xiǎo xīn, zǎo diǎn huí lái.
english: Be careful on the road, and come back early.

script: 你们的校长今天来了吗？
reading: Nǐ men de xiào zhǎng jīn tiān lái le ma?
english: Did your principal come today?

reading: Jīn tiān de xīn wén nǐ kàn le ma?
english: Did you see today's news?

script: 这个苹果很新鲜，快来吃。
reading: Zhè ge píng guǒ hěn xīn xiān, kuài lái chī.
english: This apple is really fresh, come and eat.
gloss: هٰذِهِ التُّفَّاحَةُ طَازَجَةٌ جِدًّا، تَعَالَ وَكُلْ.
gloss_reading: Hādhihi at-tuffāḥatu ṭāzajatun jiddan, taʿāla wakul.

reading: Nǐ yǒu xīn de xìn ma? Wǒ zài děng.
english: Do you have a new letter? I'm waiting.
gloss: هَلْ عِنْدَكَ رِسَالَةٌ جَدِيدَةٌ؟ أَنَا أَنْتَظِرُ.
gloss_reading: Hal ʿindaka risālatun jadīda? Anā antaẓir.

reading: Nǐ de xíng li xiāng hǎo dà a.
english: Your suitcase is so big.

reading: Wǒ xiǎng biàn chéng yì zhī dà xióng māo.
english: I want to turn into a giant panda.

reading: Wǒ xū yào nǐ zài wǒ páng biān.
english: I need you next to me.

reading: Nǐ xiǎng xuǎn zé nǎ yí gè?
english: Which one do you want to choose?

script: 我有一个小小的要求：别走。
reading: Wǒ yǒu yí gè xiǎo xiǎo de yāo qiú: bié zǒu.
english: I have one small request: don't go.

reading: Wǒ yé ye yě xǐ huan tīng yīn yuè.
english: My grandpa likes listening to music too.
gloss: جَدِّي يُحِبُّ الِاسْتِمَاعَ إِلَى الْمُوسِيقَى أَيْضًا.
gloss_reading: Jaddī yuḥibbu al-istimāʿa ilā al-mūsīqā ayḍan.

reading: Míng tiān yí dìng shì gè hǎo tiān qì.
english: Tomorrow will surely be nice weather.
gloss: سَيَكُونُ الْجَوُّ جَمِيلًا غَدًا بِلَا شَكٍّ.
gloss_reading: Sayakūnu al-jawwu jamīlan ghadan bilā shakk.

script: 今天一共有五个人来看我。
reading: Jīn tiān yí gòng yǒu wǔ gè rén lái kàn wǒ.
english: Altogether five people came to see me today.
gloss: جَاءَ خَمْسَةُ أَشْخَاصٍ لِزِيَارَتِي الْيَوْمَ فِي الْمَجْمُوعِ.
gloss_reading: Jāʾa khamsatu ashkhāṣin liziyāratī al-yawma fī al-majmūʿ.

reading: Wǒ shuì yí huìr, bié jiào wǒ.
english: I'll sleep for a bit, don't wake me.

script: 你和我一样喜欢吃蛋糕。
reading: Nǐ hé wǒ yí yàng xǐ huan chī dàn gāo.
english: You like cake just like I do.

reading: Wǒ yì zhí zài děng nǐ huí jiā.
english: I've been waiting for you to come home all along.
gloss: مَا زِلْتُ أَنْتَظِرُ عَوْدَتَكَ إِلَى الْبَيْتِ.
gloss_reading: Mā ziltu antaẓiru ʿawdataka ilā al-bayt.

reading: Yǐ qián wǒ zhù zài shuǐ lǐ.
english: I used to live in the water.
gloss: كُنْتُ أَسْكُنُ فِي الْمَاءِ مِنْ قَبْلُ.
gloss_reading: Kuntu askunu fī al-māʾi min qabl.

reading: Wǒ yì bān wǎn shang bú shuì jiào.
english: I generally don't sleep at night.

reading: Zhè ge yīn yuè zhēn hǎo tīng.
english: This music sounds really nice.

reading: Nǐ qù yín háng zuò shén me?
english: What are you going to the bank for?

reading: Wǒ xiǎng hē yì bēi lěng de yǐn liào.
english: I want a cold drink.

reading: Nǐ yīng gāi zǎo diǎn shuì jiào.
english: You should go to bed earlier.

reading: Tiān qì huì yǐng xiǎng wǒ de xīn qíng.
english: The weather affects my mood.

script: 我可以用一下你的笔吗？
reading: Wǒ kě yǐ yòng yí xià nǐ de bǐ ma?
english: Can I use your pen for a moment?
gloss: هَلْ يُمْكِنُنِي أَنْ أَسْتَخْدِمَ قَلَمَكَ لَحْظَةً؟
gloss_reading: Hal yumkinunī an astakhdima qalamaka laḥẓa?

script: 我喜欢这个游戏，再玩一次。
reading: Wǒ xǐ huan zhè ge yóu xì, zài wán yí cì.
english: I like this game, let's play once more.
gloss: تُعْجِبُنِي هٰذِهِ اللُّعْبَةُ، لِنَلْعَبْ مَرَّةً أُخْرَى.
gloss_reading: Tuʿjibunī hādhihi al-luʿba, linalʿab marratan ukhrā.

reading: Nǐ de péng you hěn yǒu míng ba?
english: Your friend is quite famous, isn't he?

reading: Nǐ zhōng yú lái le, tài hǎo le!
english: You're finally here, how wonderful!
note: settled by claude-adjudicated: blind reading means the same as the English (wording only)

script: 我今天在路上遇到一只猫。
reading: Wǒ jīn tiān zài lù shang yù dào yì zhī māo.
english: I ran into a cat on the road today.

reading: Nǐ yuàn yì hé wǒ yì qǐ wán ma?
english: Are you willing to play with me?

reading: Jīn wǎn de yuè liang yòu dà yòu liàng.
english: Tonight's moon is big and bright.

reading: Tiān yuè lái yuè lěng le.
english: It's getting colder and colder.

reading: Wǒ zài chē zhàn děng nǐ.
english: I'll wait for you at the station.

reading: Qǐng gěi wǒ yì zhāng zhǐ.
english: Please give me a sheet of paper.

script: 你怎么还不回来，我好着急。
reading: Nǐ zěn me hái bù huí lái, wǒ hǎo zháo jí.
english: Why aren't you back yet? I'm so worried.
gloss: لِمَاذَا لَمْ تَعُدْ بَعْدُ؟ أَنَا قَلِقٌ جِدًّا.
gloss_reading: Limādhā lam taʿud baʿd? Anā qaliqun jiddan.

reading: Qǐng nǐ zhào gù wǒ, hǎo ma?
english: Please take care of me, okay?

reading: Zhè zhāng zhào piàn shì shéi gěi nǐ de?
english: Who gave you this photo?

script: 我想用照相机给你照张相。
reading: Wǒ xiǎng yòng zhào xiàng jī gěi nǐ zhào zhāng xiāng.
english: I want to take your picture with the camera.
gloss: أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَلْتَقِطَ لَكَ صُورَةً بِالْكَامِيرَا.
gloss_reading: Urīdu an altaqiṭa laka ṣūratan bi-l-kāmīrā.

reading: Zhuō zi shang yǒu yì zhī xiǎo niǎo.
english: There's a little bird on the table.

reading: Wǒ zhǐ yǒu nǐ yí gè péng you.
english: You're my only friend.
note: settled by claude-adjudicated: blind reading means the same as the English (wording only)

reading: Wǒ zuò zài zhuō zi zhōng jiān.
english: I'm sitting in the middle of the table.

script: 我在学中文，你教教我吧。
reading: Wǒ zài xué zhōng wén, nǐ jiāo jiāo wǒ ba.
english: I'm learning Chinese, so teach me.

reading: Nǐ zhōng yú huí lái le!
english: You're finally back!

reading: Nǐ xǐ huan nǎ yì zhǒng shuǐ guǒ?
english: Which kind of fruit do you like?

reading: Jīn tiān de shū bāo hǎo zhòng a.
english: Today's school bag is so heavy.

reading: Nǐ zuì zhòng yào, bié zǒu.
english: You're the most important, don't go.

reading: Zhè ge zhōu mò nǐ yǒu kōng ma?
english: Are you free this weekend?
gloss: هَلْ عِنْدَكَ وَقْتٌ فِي نِهَايَةِ الْأُسْبُوعِ؟
gloss_reading: Hal ʿindaka waqtun fī nihāyati al-ʾusbūʿ?

reading: Wǒ zhǔ yào chī dàn gāo hé shuǐ guǒ.
english: I mainly eat cake and fruit.

reading: Guò mǎ lù yào zhù yì chē.
english: Pay attention to cars when crossing the road.

reading: Wǒ xiǎng zì jǐ shì yi shì.
english: I want to try it myself.

reading: Wǒ xiǎng qí zì xíng chē qù wán.
english: I want to ride a bike and play.

reading: Nǐ zǒng shì zhè me zǎo qǐ lái.
english: You always get up this early.

reading: Zuì hòu yí kuài dàn gāo gěi wǒ ba.
english: Give me the last piece of cake.

reading: Nǐ zuì jìn hǎo ma? Wǒ xiǎng nǐ le.
english: How have you been lately? I missed you.

reading: Nǐ de zuò yè zuò wán le ma?
english: Have you finished your homework?

reading: Qǐng zài shuō yí biàn.
english: Please say it once more.
gloss: أَعِدْ ذٰلِكَ مَرَّةً أُخْرَى مِنْ فَضْلِكَ.
gloss_reading: Aʿid dhālika marratan ukhrā min faḍlik.
note: settled by claude-adjudicated: blind reading means the same as the English (wording only)

script: 我家对面有一个大商店。
reading: Wǒ jiā duì miàn yǒu yí gè dà shāng diàn.
english: There's a big shop across from my home.

script: 别忘了，明天我一定要吃鱼。
reading: Bié wàng le, míng tiān wǒ yí dìng yào chī yú.
english: Don't forget, tomorrow I absolutely want fish.
gloss: لَا تَنْسَ، سَآكُلُ سَمَكًا غَدًا بِالتَّأْكِيدِ.
gloss_reading: Lā tans, saʾākulu samakan ghadan bi-t-taʾkīd.

script: 为了吃蛋糕，我一直在等。
reading: Wèi le chī dàn gāo, wǒ yì zhí zài děng.
english: I've been waiting just to have cake.
gloss: مَا زِلْتُ أَنْتَظِرُ مِنْ أَجْلِ الْكَعْكَةِ.
gloss_reading: Mā ziltu antaẓiru min ajli al-kaʿka.

script: 我们这里有三位小朋友。
reading: Wǒ men zhè lǐ yǒu sān wèi xiǎo péng you.
english: There are three little kids here.
note: settled by claude-adjudicated: blind reading means the same as the English (wording only)

reading: Wǒ xiǎng qù kàn kan bié de wén huà.
english: I want to go see other cultures.
gloss: أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَذْهَبَ لِأَرَى ثَقَافَاتٍ أُخْرَى.
gloss_reading: Urīdu an adhhaba liʾarā thaqāfātin ukhrā.

reading: Nǐ wǎng xī zǒu, wǒ wǎng dōng zǒu.
english: You go west, and I'll go east.
gloss: اِذْهَبْ أَنْتَ نَحْوَ الْغَرْبِ، وَأَنَا سَأَذْهَبُ نَحْوَ الشَّرْقِ.
gloss_reading: Idhhab anta naḥwa al-gharb, waʾanā saʾadhhabu naḥwa ash-sharq.

reading: Nǐ de xīn xí guàn shì shén me?
english: What's your new habit?

script: 我一个人不想去洗手间。
reading: Wǒ yí gè rén bù xiǎng qù xǐ shǒu jiān.
english: I don't want to go to the restroom alone.
gloss: لَا أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَذْهَبَ إِلَى دَوْرَةِ الْمِيَاهِ وَحْدِي.
gloss_reading: Lā urīdu an adhhaba ilā dawrati al-miyāhi waḥdī.

reading: Xǐ wán zǎo, wǒ jué de hěn shū fu.
english: After a bath I feel really comfortable.

reading: Xià tiān de wǎn shang hěn shū fu.
english: Summer nights are really pleasant.

reading: Wǒ xiǎng xiān shuì, nǐ yě zǎo diǎn shuì.
english: I want to sleep first, and you sleep early too.
gloss: أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَنَامَ أَوَّلًا، وَأَنْتَ نَمْ مُبَكِّرًا أَيْضًا.
gloss_reading: Urīdu an anāma awwalan, waʾanta nam mubakkiran ayḍan.

reading: Wǒ xǐ huan zhè ge xiǎo gù shì.
english: I like this little story.

reading: Xiāng jiāo shì wǒ zuì ài de shuǐ guǒ.
english: Bananas are my favorite fruit.

reading: Wǒ xiàng nǐ pǎo guò qù le.
english: I ran over toward you.

reading: Nǐ xiàng wǒ de gē ge yí yàng.
english: You're like a big brother to me.

reading: Xiǎo xīn, bié bǎ wǒ fàng zài dì shang.
english: Careful, don't put me on the floor.

reading: Xiào zhǎng jīn tiān méi yǒu lái xué xiào.
english: The principal didn't come to school today.
gloss: لَمْ يَأْتِ مُدِيرُ الْمَدْرَسَةِ إِلَى الْمَدْرَسَةِ الْيَوْمَ.
gloss_reading: Lam yaʾti mudīru al-madrasati ilā al-madrasati al-yawm.

reading: Wǒ zài diàn shì shàng kàn xīn wén.
english: I'm watching the news on TV.

script: 我要新鲜的鱼，不要旧的。
reading: Wǒ yào xīn xiān de yú, bú yào jiù de.
english: I want fresh fish, not old.

reading: Wǒ gěi yé ye xiě le xìn.
english: I wrote a letter to my grandpa.

reading: Nǐ de xíng li xiāng lǐ yǒu shén me?
english: What is in your suitcase?

reading: Xióng māo yě xǐ huan chī dōng xi.
english: Pandas like eating too.

reading: Wǒ xū yào xiū xi yí xià.
english: I need to rest for a bit.

script: 选择太多了，我不知道吃什么。
reading: Xuǎn zé tài duō le, wǒ bù zhī dào chī shén me.
english: There are too many choices, and I don't know what to eat.
gloss: الْخِيَارَاتُ كَثِيرَةٌ جِدًّا، لَا أَعْرِفُ مَاذَا آكُلُ.
gloss_reading: Al-khiyārātu kathīratun jiddan, lā aʿrifu mādhā ākul.

reading: Nǐ de yāo qiú wǒ dōu jì zhù le.
english: I've remembered all your requests.

reading: Yé ye de jiā hěn dà.
english: Grandpa's home is very big.

reading: Wǒ yí dìng huì hǎo hǎo tīng huà.
english: I'll definitely be good and listen.

reading: Wǒ men yí gòng yǒu jǐ gè rén?
english: How many of us are there altogether?
note: settled by claude-adjudicated: blind reading means the same as the English (wording only)

reading: Nǐ děng wǒ yí huìr, hǎo ma?
english: Wait for me a moment, okay?

script: 你是我的家人，我很放心。
reading: Nǐ shì wǒ de jiā rén, wǒ hěn fàng xīn.
english: You're my family, so I feel at ease.

reading: Wǒ yì zhí xiǎng yǒu gè péng you.
english: I've always wanted a friend.
gloss: كُنْتُ أُرِيدُ دَائِمًا أَنْ يَكُونَ لِي صَدِيقٌ.
gloss_reading: Kuntu urīdu dāʾiman an yakūna lī ṣadīq.

reading: Yǐ qián de rì zi yě hěn hǎo.
english: The days before were nice too.

script: 我们一般什么时候吃饭？
reading: Wǒ men yì bān shén me shí hou chī fàn?
english: When do we usually eat?

reading: Wǒ zài tīng yīn yuè, bié shuō huà.
english: I'm listening to music, so don't talk.

reading: Wǒ men qù yín háng páng biān wán ba.
english: Let's go play next to the bank.

reading: Zhè bēi yǐn liào shì shéi de?
english: Whose drink is this?

reading: Wǒ yīng gāi qù shuì jiào le.
english: I should go to sleep now.

reading: Tiān qì huì yǐng xiǎng wǒ shuì jiào.
english: The weather affects my sleep.

reading: Nǐ yòng shén me tīng yīn yuè?
english: What do you use to listen to music?

reading: Wǒ men zài wán yí gè yóu xì ba.
english: Let's play another game.

reading: Zhè lǐ zuì yǒu míng de shì shén me?
english: What's the most famous thing here?

reading: Nǐ yòu wàng jì chī fàn le ma?
english: Did you forget to eat again?
gloss: هَلْ نَسِيتَ أَنْ تَأْكُلَ مَرَّةً أُخْرَى؟
gloss_reading: Hal nasīta an taʾkula marratan ukhrā?

reading: Wǒ jīn tiān yù dào hěn duō péng you.
english: I ran into lots of friends today.

script: 我愿意一直和你在一起。
reading: Wǒ yuàn yì yì zhí hé nǐ zài yì qǐ.
english: I'm willing to stay with you always.
gloss: أَرْغَبُ فِي أَنْ أَبْقَى مَعَكَ دَائِمًا.
gloss_reading: Arghabu fī an abqā maʿaka dāʾiman.

reading: Yuè liang chū lái le, wǎn ān.
english: The moon is out, good night.

reading: Wǒ yuè chī yuè xiǎng chī.
english: The more I eat, the more I want.

script: 车站的人很多，我有点怕。
reading: Chē zhàn de rén hěn duō, wǒ yǒu diǎn pà.
english: There are lots of people at the station, and I'm a bit scared.
gloss: النَّاسُ كَثِيرُونَ فِي الْمَحَطَّةِ، أَنَا خَائِفٌ قَلِيلًا.
gloss_reading: An-nāsu kathīrūna fī al-maḥaṭṭa, anā khāʾifun qalīlan.

script: 我想要一个礼物，你能送我吗？
reading: Wǒ xiǎng yào yí gè lǐ wù, nǐ néng sòng wǒ ma?
english: I want a present. Can you give me one?

reading: Wǒ xǐ huan tīng lì shǐ gù shì.
english: I like listening to history stories.

script: 附近有一个公园，我们去玩吧！
reading: Fù jìn yǒu yí gè gōng yuán, wǒ men qù wán ba!
english: There is a park nearby. Let's go and play!

script: 我一边吃饭，一边看电视。
reading: Wǒ yì biān chī fàn, yì biān kàn diàn shì.
english: I am eating and watching TV at the same time.
gloss: آكُلُ وَأُشَاهِدُ التِّلْفَازَ فِي الْوَقْتِ نَفْسِهِ.
gloss_reading: Ākulu waʾushāhidu at-tilfāza fī al-waqti nafsih.

reading: Wǒ de zuǐ hǎo gān, xiǎng hē shuǐ.
english: My mouth is so dry. I want some water.
gloss: فَمِي جَافٌّ جِدًّا، أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَشْرَبَ مَاءً.
gloss_reading: Famī jāffun jiddan, urīdu an ashraba māʾan.
